hints.title: Parity Count Feasibility
hints.text: Collect indices of even and odd numbers; if their counts differ by more than one, alternating parity is impossible.

hints.title: Target Alignment Patterns
hints.text: Determine whether even numbers must occupy even indices, odd indices, or if both configurations are possible.

hints.title: Displacement Distance Sum
hints.text: The minimum number of adjacent swaps equals the sum of absolute differences between current and target positions.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan collecting parity index positions and calculating coordinate displacements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating individual swap operations leads to quadratic simulation time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Index arrays use linear space to evaluate target distances directly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use index displacement sums rather than simulating element-by-element swaps.
